text:
elaine_sales: Hey team, NovaHealth just signed an internal OK to run a 6-week POC. They want a Dedicated GPU pool for inference (HIPAA workload). Can we size/provision?

max_se: Congrats. Quick baseline ask from them in call: ~100 concurrent requests, avg prompt+response ~800 tokens, target p50 latency < 200ms, target p95 < 500ms. They want guidance: A100-40G vs H100-80G. Region preference: us-west2 but open to eu-west1 for redundancy.

ops_infra: Head's up — typical lead time for Dedicated pools (H100) is ~48–72h for provisioning and infra setup once we have SKU/region and VPC details. A100 can be faster if capacity is available. Need subnet CIDR and peering contact.

elaine_sales: They also asked about burst capacity for demo spikes and cost estimate for 2-week pilot with roughly 500k tokens/day. Could you provide rough $/hour and whether autoscale will handle spikes?

max_se: Autoscale can handle spikes but we recommend a min of 2 GPUs + burst to 6-8 GPUs. For this workload H100 gives better throughput/latency at higher token sizes — fewer context swaps. A100-40G might run out of KV-cache headroom with long context + concurrency.

max_se: Quick recommendation:
```yaml
pool_config:
  sku: h100-80g
  region: us-west2
  min_gpus: 2
  max_gpus: 8
  reserved_tps_equiv: "~20 reqs/s (based on 800 tokens avg)"
  kv_cache: enabled
  quant_profile: dynamic-8bit
  vpc: requires_peering
```

max_se: Rough cost: H100 reserved pool burn ~ $X.XX/hr per GPU (internal estimate) — ballpark for pilot (2->6 GPUs typical) ~ $Yk for 2 weeks. I can run a more exact calc if they give expected tokens/day and percent of peak.

nova_poc_team: Hi all — we can provide IP ranges for peering. Also need Hosted API key access for engineers to smoke-test before dedicated is ready. HIPAA controls: do you support CME logs + KMS?

security_bot: For HIPAA customers we require: VPC peering for Dedicated, CMEK (customer-managed keys) for at-rest model artifacts, audit logs retention config, and signed BAA. Send security questionnaire to security@redwood and we'll loop in compliance.

ops_infra: Also note — if they want EU region for data residency we need to reserve capacity there. H100 in eu-west1 has limited slots this quarter; we can place soft-hold but need confirmation within 24h.

max_se: If they want temporary hosted keys to unblock devs, we can issue time-limited API keys scoped to a staging project (no PHI in hosted test). Recommend they use hosted for integration tests, keep PHI to Dedicated region once provisioned.

deploy-bot: pool-request created: PR-4981 (ops queue). ETA: pending SKU confirmation.

elaine_sales: Next steps for me to act on: 1) confirm SKU choice with NovaHealth (they prefer H100 if cost OK), 2) collect VPC CIDR and peering contact, 3) send SOW & pilot pricing, 4) request hosted test keys for non-PHI devs.

nova_poc_team: We prefer H100 based on perf call. I'll get VPC CIDR and peering contact by EOD. Can you send the SOW draft?

max_se: I'll put together a tighter cost projection and a short-run perf estimate (expected req/s per GPU). Also will add recommended autoscale policy: burst window 120s, cooldown 300s, prewarm one shard before external demo.

ops_infra: Once we have CIDR + SKU + signed SOW, we can schedule provisioning and peer setup. Leave ops_infra in the loop for maintenance windows.

elaine_sales: Great — I'll send SOW and security questionnaire link to customer now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
